passage: The steep rice terraces carved into the mountainsides of the northern Philippines have been cultivated for many centuries, and the question of how they have survived so long has drawn researchers into the villages that tend them. Drawing on three decades of fieldwork in these highland communities, ______
question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.text: the resilience of the terraces, in these researchers' view, owes less to their original engineering than to the constant communal repair the villages carry out each year.
the terraces' survival was, in the researchers' view, a product of constant communal repair rather than of the original engineering that shaped them.
the constant communal repair the villages carry out each year, the researchers contend, matters more to the terraces' survival than their original engineering does.
researchers have concluded that the resilience of the terraces owes less to their original engineering than to the constant communal repair the villages carry out.

explanation: The correct answer is D. The sentence opens with the modifier "Drawing on three decades of fieldwork in these highland communities," which has to attach to whoever carried out that fieldwork. Only choice D begins the main clause with "researchers," so the people who did the fieldwork are the ones the modifier describes. Choices A, C, and D open instead with "the resilience," "the constant communal repair," and "the terraces' survival," leaving the modifier dangling, as if an abstraction rather than a person had spent three decades doing fieldwork.
